Reported homeowner population. In Texas, 19,747,876 people (66.8% of residents living in households) live in an owner-occupied home, across 6,879,255 owner households (62.6% homeownership rate). In Albright Family's 30 counties combined, 15,040,253 people (64.9%) live in owner-occupied homes, across 5,130,879 owner households (60.1% homeownership rate). The lowest county rate is Dallas County at 50.8% and the highest is Rockwall County at 82.5%. These counts cover all ages; Census doesn't publish homeowners broken out by the 30 to 64 age range. How to read this

Multi-policy vs single-item is counted per buyer from the item count on each bound sale, so it's exact. The by-source table uses GOAL's own Sold/Items pixels grouped by source — GOAL doesn't tag an individual policy with its source, so this is the platform's aggregate attribution, not a per-buyer join. "Prior carrier" is the existing coverage on the matched prospect record.
